title: Mist install ledger entry
description: One line of install-ledger.jsonl. Append-only. Two record types: an install decision, and a correction to an earlier record. scripts/check-ledger.mjs validates against THIS FILE -- it does not carry its own copy of the rules, so the schema cannot drift from the checker.

type.description: Optional on install records; absent means install.

seq.description: Contiguous, strictly increasing across the whole file. A gap means a record was lost.

ts.description: UTC, second precision. Contemporaneous: written at install time, never backfilled.

session.description: Zero-padded session id. Must have a matching docs/construction-log/<session>-*.md narrative.

actor.description: Who made the decision. Human installs are expected and are not a failure of the method.

package.description: Direct dependency name as it appears in package.json. Transitive packages are attributed to the direct install that pulled them in, never ledgered separately.

range.description: The semver range written into package.json, e.g. ^0.5.45.

prompt.description: CONTEMPORANEOUS. The intent that produced the install, in the words used at the time. Never revised.

alternativesConsidered.description: CONTEMPORANEOUS. Empty is the honest common case and carries no penalty. Do not backfill.

deliberation.description: CONTEMPORANEOUS. reflex = installed without stopping. brief = a moment's thought or one comparison. researched = alternatives actually evaluated. This field carries the argument; see docs/CONSTRUCTION.md.

packagesAdded.description: Transitive packages this one decision added. The cost of the convenience, at the moment it was incurred.

transitiveTotalAfter.description: Total transitive package count immediately after the install, from `npm ls --all --parseable | wc -l`. Same measure as surface.transitivePackages in EPIC-03's scan-run schema -- one definition, so the dashboard and the ledger cannot disagree.

note.description: RETROSPECTIVE. Hindsight is legitimate and lives only here. Adding a note to an existing record requires a correction entry, never an edit.

corrects.description: The seq of the record being corrected. That record is NOT edited.

field.description: Which field the correction concerns. Omit for a whole-record correction.

value.description: The corrected value, if the correction supplies one.

reason.description: Why the original was wrong. A correction with no reason is an edit wearing a costume.
